items.title: What Does Eli Lilly (LLY) Gain From Its $2.88 Billion Immunology Deal?
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) agreed to acquire Merida Biosciences in a deal valued at up to US$2.88b to expand its immunology pipeline. The transaction brings Merida's platform for selectively degrading pathogenic autoantibodies while maintaining normal immune function into Lilly's portfolio. Merida's lead autoimmune and allergy candidate is in Phase 1 and is expected to support Lilly's move beyond its established focus on diabetes and obesity therapies. items.title: Is Johnson & Johnson Stock Priced For More Growth Than It Has Guided?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) has had a good year. The stock is up 56.5% over the past twelve months against 19.1% for the S&P 500, and at $271.19 sits at about 99% of its 52-week high. The business is still growing. The risk is that the current stock price discounts an acceleration well ahead of management's near-term guidance.
